records.issue_text: Email send failures in sendAddGuestsEmails are swallowed via console.log without preserving the actual error, hiding production notification failures
records.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` call is wrapped in a `try/catch` that only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")` and discards the caught `err`.
